judge: data-evals (Claude), by eye, sticker vs its photo; contact sheet on cream #FFF4E0 and a check sheet on green to show halos

rubric.recognisable: 1 if someone who saw only the photo would pick this sticker as the same dish or drink: same item, its main colours, vessel shape and signature garnish. Generic-but-right (a cheese wedge for Comte) counts. 0 if it shows a different item or loses what makes it that item.
rubric.style: 1 only if all hold: (a) flat fills, no gradients, texture or photo detail beyond one highlight; (b) thick dark-brown outlines on the item's shapes; (c) a white die-cut border all round; (d) transparent outside, corners alpha 0, no leftover white or background visible on green; (e) no text, logos, table or scene; (f) reads as the same set as 01/02/11 (pastel backing, shape matches the yum number: odd round, even rounded square).
